description: Docs + finalize (Task G). Deploy/operations docs for the ghcr.io pull-based Quadlet deploy, the one-time host state-dir + .path enablement, the release flow, the one-click update experience, and the migration-rollback caveat; then refresh SESSION_STATE.md and the codebase index. Runs last because it documents what FEAT-002..004 shipped.
steps: Update docs/DEPLOYMENT_MANUAL.md and docs/OPERATIONS.md: a from-scratch 'deploy anywhere with Podman Quadlet from pre-built ghcr.io images' procedure (install the Quadlet units, provide .env, start the user services, reach the UI at :8080).

Document the one-time host state-dir + .path enablement (finding 2): the state dir (default ~/vf-cmdb/state, VF_UPDATE_DIR configurable) MUST pre-exist before the backend container starts (it bind-mounts it) AND before enabling vf-cmdb-update.path (a .path whose watched parent dir is missing fails to start); exact commands: `mkdir -p ~/vf-cmdb/state`; `systemctl --user daemon-reload`; `systemctl --user enable --now vf-cmdb-update.path`; note the oneshot vf-cmdb-update.service has NO [Install] (pulled by the .path + daily .timer) and the backend Volume mount and the .path watch target share this one dir.

Document the .path drops-an-in-flight-click behavior (finding 3): a click during an in-flight update is intentionally dropped; the operator waits for the UI to show succeeded/failed before clicking again; the UI greys 'Update now' while status is running; there is no self-retrigger loop.

Document the release workflow for the maintainer: push to master for :edge/:sha-*; tag vX.Y.Z (primary) OR run workflow_dispatch (fallback) to cut :latest + :vX.Y.Z + a GitHub Release. Include the finding-5 caveat: only dispatch/tag a version >= the current latest; do not move GitHub 'latest' backward (that would break update detection); dispatching an already-existing version re-cuts the Release/images in place and does not move the tag.
Document the in-app update experience (version shown in the footer, update-available badge, one-click 'Update now') and state explicitly it is notify-and-apply, never auto-apply.

Document the migration-cannot-be-rolled-back caveat PROMINENTLY in the update/operations docs: because entrypoint.sh runs `alembic upgrade head` on every start, re-pulling an older image does NOT undo a migration; the pre-update DB backup (deploy/scripts/vf-cmdb-backup.sh) restored via deploy/scripts/vf-cmdb-restore.sh is the only rollback safety net.

State the no-auth trust model explicitly (single user, private network, anonymous public image pulls) and the one-time 'flip the GHCR package to PUBLIC after the first release' step (the first release.yml run creates the package private by default; until flipped, anonymous host pulls fail — which degrades silently in the UI, but one-click update reports failed with an image-pull error).

Refresh SESSION_STATE.md with a new dated round entry: status, current HEAD, and what shipped for deploy-and-auto-update. Update MEMORY_BANK.md only if a hard rule changed (it did not — leave it unless a change is genuinely required).
Run `./cbindex build` from the repo root so the index matches the new code.
acceptance_criteria: docs/DEPLOYMENT_MANUAL.md and docs/OPERATIONS.md cover: ghcr.io pull deploy, the state-dir + vf-cmdb-update.path one-time enablement (finding 2), the dropped-in-flight-click note (finding 3), release-by-tag + workflow_dispatch with the don't-move-latest-backward caveat (finding 5), the notify-and-apply update flow, the migration-rollback caveat, the no-auth trust model, and the GHCR-flip-to-public note.
SESSION_STATE.md has a new dated entry naming the deploy-and-auto-update feature and the current HEAD; the dated history is preserved.
findings:
DONE. Docs-only + finalize; no code changed. All FEAT-005 verification green.

* docs/DEPLOYMENT_MANUAL.md: overview now points to the new §9 and names the two deploy models. Added §9 'Deploy anywhere from pre-built ghcr.io images (Podman Quadlet)' with: 9.0 prerequisites (Podman >=4.4, linger, jq/curl, packages must be PUBLIC, host layout $HOME/vf-cmdb/{deploy,state,.env} distinct from a source checkout); 9.1 the one-time host state dir (default ~/vf-cmdb/state, VF_UPDATE_DIR) that MUST pre-exist before the backend container start (bind-mount) AND before enabling vf-cmdb-update.path, with the exact `mkdir -p ~/vf-cmdb/state` and the note that the backend Volume mount target and the .path watch target are the same dir (finding 2); 9.2 install Quadlet units; 9.3 .env; 9.4 start services (daemon-reload + start db/backend/frontend/pgadmin, UI at :8080); 9.5 enable --now vf-cmdb-update.path + .timer AFTER the state dir exists + backend running, with the explicit no-[Install] oneshot note (finding 2); 9.6 one-click + daily update summary with the prominent migration-rollback caveat; 9.7 no-auth trust model.
* docs/OPERATIONS.md: top-of-file prominent migration-cannot-be-rolled-back warning naming backup/restore scripts. §1 rewritten to the ghcr pull model + the container/host trust-boundary (marker + .path + status file). §2 is now the maintainer release workflow (build.yml push master -> :edge/:sha-*; release.yml tag v* primary OR workflow_dispatch fallback -> :latest/:v<version> + Release) with the finding-5 don't-move-latest-backward caveat (only publish version >= current latest; dispatch/tag of an existing version re-cuts in place and does not move the tag) and the one-time flip-GHCR-packages-to-PUBLIC step (first release.yml run creates them private; until flipped anonymous pulls fail -> UI degrades silently but one-click reports failed with an image-pull error). §3 rewritten to the host pull-based update: 3.1 one-click notify-and-apply (never auto-apply) with the dropped-in-flight-click behavior (.path coalesces + script lock + UI greys 'Update now' while running + no self-retrigger loop; finding 3) and the restart/180s health-check window; 3.2 manual shell + --dry-run; 3.3 daily timer + the no-[Install] oneshot note; freeze/resume commands for both .timer and .path. §5 health checks gained /api/v1/meta/version and update.status. New §7 no-auth trust model; monthly checklist (now §8) checks the .path watcher is active.
* SESSION_STATE.md: header Last Updated -> 2026-09-10, Project Phase/Status updated to record deploy-and-auto-update COMPLETE; new dated top-of-history round entry summarizing FEAT-002..005 (commits 48167f9/4f33fa2/68952e3 + this docs commit) and the hard-rule note (Alembic head stays 0037, no migration added). Dated history preserved.
* MEMORY_BANK.md: unchanged (no hard rule changed).
